Ahhh, yes. That changes the shape of the evidence quite a bit. 😄
So the actual sequence is:
Gemini connected → spoke several rounds ✅
Luma added → Luma spoke ✅
Gemini continued → one or more silent turns ❌

That's exactly the kind of squirrel we're hunting. 🐿️🔮🦆
